verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs show natural-language operation across many surfaces. Users can type '#' to describe a command and have it generated in real time, including inside interactive tools. Agent Mode lets users prompt in natural language and have the agent write code, run commands and iterate. The standalone agent CLI accepts natural-language prompts alongside shell commands. Hands-on community reports corroborate it: users rely on AI-generated commands and on asking the agent to find, examine and suggest deleting old files, and one calls it 'magic for linux sys admin.'
